title: UI风格#73 - Nordic Wood (北欧木语)
description: 创建第73种UI风格：北欧木语风格 - 斯堪的纳维亚、木材质感、自然简约。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planBU.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Wood style When color palette Then features warm wood tones, crisp white, forest green, stone gray
Given Nordic Wood style When typography Then uses nordic fonts: Montserrat, Fira Sans, or Nunito
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Montserrat (headers 3rem 600 weight), Fira Sans (body 0.95rem 300-500 weight)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Wood style When layout Then wood grain textures, simple lines, nature elements
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: parchment texture, birch inner border, light-wood color palette, forest-green/moss gradient accents

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Wood style When UI elements Then wood panels, leaf accents, stone textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: wood-brown borders, forest-green/moss top gradients on cards, light-wood/birch borders, clean minimal hover transitions

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Wood UI When functional Then includes cabin chat, forest agents, wood stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: cabin chat, 4 forest agents (Pine/Deer/Owl/Bear) with Timber/Calm/Trails/Grace/Wisdom/Watch/Strength/Nature stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Wood UI When copy Then uses forest nordic: 'Forest', ' cabin', 'Nature', 'Simple'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'FOREST. CABIN. SIMPLE.', tagline 'SCANDINAVIAN SIMPLICITY', button 'HIKE', greeting 'Welcome to our woodland retreat', status 'Hiking'/'Idle', nav 'Forest'/'Trail'/'Lodge'/'Summit'
